scope: Remove Report review stages and allow authorized Supervisors to correct submitted Reports in the app.

behavior.workers: See current corrected Reports; cannot edit submitted Reports.
behavior.concurrency: Expected revision is required. A stale save is rejected and browser edits remain available until explicit Cancel.
behavior.exports: CSV, HTML and PDF downloads reflect the current Report without retired workflow columns.
behavior.email: Original queued email snapshots, recipients and evidence remain frozen. Corrections do not resend email.
behavior.legacy: Retained Daywork approval and editing behavior remains separate.

validation.sequence: The full mobile gate passed. Final copy-only translations/sidebar wording and operational documentation were followed by a fresh build, shell parity check and lint. The stricter frozen-Definition validator also passed a final native PostgreSQL correction follow-up.

release_requirements: Deploy additive 0025_report_corrections and its compatible backend before this Hosting shell.
Rehearse the complete release and preserve a 0025-compatible fallback; do not downgrade the migration ledger.
Preserve existing accounts, authentication generations and device storage.
limits: No commit, push, remote CI, deployment, hosted application fixture, production data change, IAM change or real email was performed.
No physical iOS/Android validation or new hosted/offline-update validation is claimed.

This initial local checkpoint preceded release preparation. Historical hosted verifiers were subsequently adapted and rehearsed locally; their authenticated hosted execution remains a separate release check.
Report corrections require connectivity and have no persistent offline correction draft.
Missing or invalid original Definition snapshots block correction without changing saved content.
The existing build chunk-size advisory remains.
